tokens.iast: atha sadyaḥsamutkrāntipradā dīkṣā nirūpyate / tatkṣaṇāccopabhogādvā dehapāte śivaṃ vrajet / ityuktyā mālinīśāstre sūcitāsau maheśinā dehapāte samīpasthe śaktipātasphuṭatvataḥ / āsādya śāṃkarīṃ dīkṣāṃ tasmāddīkṣākṣaṇātparam śivaṃ vrajedityartho@tra pūrvāparavivecanāt / vyākhyātaḥ śrīmatāsmākaṃ guruṇā śambhumūrtinā yadā hyāsannamaraṇe śaktipātaḥ prajāyate / tatra mande@tha gurvādisevayāyuḥ kṣayaṃ vrajet athavā bandhumitrādidvārā sāsya vibhoḥ patet / pūrvaṃ vā samayī naiva parāṃ dīkṣāmavāptavān āptadīkṣo@pi vā prāṇāñjihāsuḥ kleśavarjitam / antyāngurustadā kuryātsadya+utkrāntidīkṣaṇam natvapakvamale nāpi śeṣakārmikavigrahe / kuryādutkramaṇaṃ śrīmadgahvare ca nirūpitam dṛṣṭvā śiṣyaṃ jarāgrastaṃ vyādhinā paripīḍitam / utkramayya tatastvenaṃ paratattve niyojayet viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatve kāmacāravidhānataḥ / pūrvoktamarthajātaṃ śrīśambhunātra nirūpitam vidhiṃ pūrvoditaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvā samayaśuddhitaḥ / kṣurikāmasya vinyasyejjvalantīṃ marmakartarīm

tokens.iast: kṛtvā pūrvoditaṃ nyāsaṃ kālānalasamaprabham / saṃhṛtikramataḥ sārdhaṃ sṛkchindiyugalena tu āgneyīṃ dhāraṇāṃ kṛtvā sarvamarmapratāpanīm / pūrayedvāyunā dehamaṅguṣṭhānmastakāntakam tamutkṛṣya tato@ṅguṣṭhādūrdhvāntaṃ vakṣyamāṇayā / kṛntenmarmāṇi randhrāntāt kālarātryā visarjayet anena kramayogena yojito hutivarjitaḥ / samayyapyeti tāṃ dīkṣāmiti śrīmālinīmate ṣoḍaśādhāraṣaṭcakralakṣyatrayakhapañcakāt / kvacidanyataratrātha prāguktapaśukarmavat praviśya mūlaṃ kandādeśchindannaikyavibhāvanāt / pūrṇāhutiprayogeṇa sveṣṭe dhāmni niyojayet jñānatriśūlaṃ saṃdīptaṃ dīptacakratrayojjvalam / cintayitvāmunā tasya vedanaṃ bodhanaṃ bhramam dīpanaṃ tāḍanaṃ todaṃ calanaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ / kandādicakragaṃ kuryādviśeṣeṇa hṛdambuje dvādaśānte tataḥ kṛtvā binduyugmagate kṣipet / nirlakṣye vā pare dhāmni saṃyuktaḥ parameśvaraḥ na tasya kuryātsaṃskāraṃ kaṃcidityāha gahvare / devaḥ kimasya pūrṇasya śrāddhādyairiti bhāvitaḥ

tokens.iast: śrīmaddīkṣottare tveṣa vidhirvahnipuṭīkṛtaḥ / haṃsaḥ pumānadhastasya rudrabindusamanvitaḥ śiṣyadehe niyojyaitadanudvagnaḥ śataṃ japet / utkramyordhvanimeṣeṇa śiṣya itthaṃ paraṃ vrajet eṣa eva vidhiḥ śrīmatsiddhayogīśvarīmate / iyamutkrāmaṇī dīkṣā kartavyā yogino guroḥ anabhyastaprāṇacāraḥ kathamenāṃ kariṣyati / vakṣyamāṇāṃ brahmavidyāṃ sakalāṃ niṣkalombhitām karṇe@sya vā paṭhedbhūyo bhūyo vāpyatha pāṭhayet / svayaṃ ca karma kurvīta tattvaśuddhyādikaṃ guruḥ mantrakriyābalātpūrṇāhutyetthaṃ yojayetpare / yogābhyāsamakṛtvāpi sadya+utkrāntidāṃ guruḥ jñānamantrakriyādhyānabalātkartuṃ bhavetprabhuḥ / anayotkramyate śiṣyo balādevaikakaṃ kṣaṇam kālasyollaṅghya bhogo hi kṣaṇiko@syāstu kiṃ tataḥ / sadya+utkrāntidā cānyā yasyāṃ pūrṇāhutiṃ tadā dadyādyadāsya prāṇāḥ syurdhruvaṃ niṣkramaṇecchavaḥ / vināpi kriyayā bhāvibrahmavidyābalādguruḥ karṇajāpaprayogeṇa tattvakañcukajālataḥ / niḥsārayanyathābhīṣṭe sakale niṣkale dvaye
